title: Introducing Coinbase Tokenize | Brian Armstrong, CEO
description:
Coinbase is bullish on tokenization. CEO Brian Armstrong announces Coinbase Tokenize, a new
end-to-end solution for bringing offchain assets onchain—combining issuance, custody, compliance, trading, and distribution all in one place.

__

At Coinbase, our mission is to create an open financial system for the world.

✅ Subscribe to our channel here: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCofTOFX4QuhT8OY-3-fFRFw/?sub_confirmation=1

#coinbase #crypto #bitcoin #blockchain 

__

This content is being provided to you for informational purposes only. Nothing discussed in this video is intended to be investment advice. This content, and any information contained therein, does not constitute a recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument referenced in the content.

asr.full_text: But before we wrap up, I wanna share with you one more thing. For years now, we've been hearing strong demand from funds and asset managers that are looking to tokenize real-world assets. Like us, they believe that crypto rails can democratize access to capital markets, improve liquidity, eliminate settlement risk, and reduce back office fees. We've actually been tokenizing assets for many years at Coinbase with rapt bitcoin and stablecoins but that was just the beginning. So today, we're excited to introduce another new product, Coinbase Tokenize. Coinbase Tokenize is our end-to-end solution for bringing off- assets on chain. It combines issuance, custody, compliance and trading all in one place. Coinbase is uniquely situated to create a market for tokenized assets. On the one hand we have millions of retail and institutional investors who hold over $500 billion in assets on our platform and they are looking for differentiated opportunities to invest in. On the other hand we work with the world's largest institutions and funds already from equities to private companies, funds, real estate, and more. This is the future we're building toward, where assets move at the speed of the Internet. If you're a company or institution looking to tokenize your assets, get in touch with us. So that's our update. Increasing... . Increasing economic freedom in the world has always been our mission, and these products are how we deliver it to you. The future of finance is on Coinbase. Thank you so much.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents Coinbase Tokenize as a business service for companies and institutions seeking to tokenize assets, including asset issuance, custody, compliance, and trading. The visible website and QR code are described as routes to product information, while the material is characterized as informational and not investment advice. No request for payment, credentials, or participation in a deceptive investment scheme is described.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central subject is an ordinary business service presented by its provider: Coinbase Tokenize is described as a service for companies and institutions that combines asset issuance, custody, compliance and trading, with an invitation to contact Coinbase.
